Description

History

After a hard week — my father's death anniversary, a family conflict, a nasty breakup — the game concept came to me on a cliche rainy night when I had wished for mercy.

I had met Wilson of WilkGames a few times before; Brunei is a small world, and the local game dev scene is smaller. One afternoon he asked what kind of game I wanted to make. By the end of same afternoon, Mercy now becomes Damai and the core of the game had taken shape.

- Fatimah, Ervarawr Studio

Features

  • One lady
  • Enter the stage with unique weapons to combat

About the Developers

About Ervarawr Studio
Ervarawr Studio is founded in June 2026, a game development studio in Brunei.
About WilkGames
WilKGames is a Brunei-based independent game development studio and creative initiative founded in 2021. Rooted in a passion for playful storytelling and community empowerment, WilKGames creates unique, accessible games that celebrate local culture and embrace bold, imaginative mechanics.
